mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 5.0% for two consecutive months, it indicates a tightening labor market that accelerates consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signal robust aggregate demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or interaction term coefficient is insignificant (p>0.05) over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of rising industrial production (INDPRO > 100), supply chain constraints ease, reducing input costs and boosting corporate margins, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 100, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) over the past three months indicates strong household demand that supports corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE) and increase in employment (PAYEMS) signals labor market strengthening that boosts disposable income and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in UNRATE and increase in PAYEMS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or interaction term coefficient is insignificant (p>0.05) over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-interest-rate regime (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), a decline in the federal funds rate signals a shift toward monetary easing that reduces recession risk, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
